newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli diamond exports up 5.4 pct in February.
newsitem.headline: Israeli diamond exports up 5.4 pct in February.

text.p: Israel's net exports of polished diamonds rose 5.4 percent in February from a year earlier to $349 million, the Industry and Trade Ministry said on Sunday.
The increase followed a seven percent rise in January and a four percent rise for all of 1996. In the first two months of 1997, net exports were up 12 percent to $974 million, the ministry said.
Tsafrir Anbar, the head of the diamond unit at the ministry, said most of the rise in February was due to exports to the United States.

The ministry said that in quantity terms exports were unchanged in the first two months of 1997 compared with a year ago but that measured in carats the increase was 39 percent, which increased the value of exports.
